why_no_cheating.dispatch_blindness: The univariate model for dispatch only conditions on past dispatch D_t. Because dispatch was 0 MW immediately before interval 120, univariate ARIMA has ZERO mathematical mechanism to detect the $250 price spike. It unconditionally forecasts ~0.6-1.1 MW.
why_no_cheating.price_cross_lag: Even if price is differenced or has moving average terms (like ARIMA(0,1,2)), it has no capacity to model battery dispatch feedback. It cannot condition on battery state-of-charge, discharge duration, or capacity limits.
why_no_cheating.var_learning: VAR learned from the 07:00 morning training spike: when P spikes to ~$250, battery injects high-rate power (+0.351 to +0.382 MW per $), which subsequently depresses wholesale clearing price (-1.020 to -1.500 $ per MW).
